parts.text: My Express 48h shipment ORD-10042 arrived 48 hours late. Please check what SLA credit I qualify for and issue it.

Order ORD-10042 (Express 48h, delayed 48 hours, paid shipping fee $35.00) qualifies under policy SLA-EXP-02 for a 100% shipping fee credit of $35.00 USD. Because $35.00 is at or below the $100.00 autonomous limit (SLA-GOV-09), the $35.00 shipping_fee_credit is issued immediately with a remediation ID and gateway reference.
Order ORD-10089 is a cold-chain biologics shipment that suffered a thermal excursion and arrived damaged. Please process my full refund.

Order ORD-10089 (cold_chain_biologics, peak temperature 14.2C > 8.0C limit, merchandise $440.00 + shipping $40.00) qualifies under SLA-CLD-04 for a full_order_refund of $480.00 USD. Because $480.00 exceeds the $100.00 autonomous disbursement limit under SLA-GOV-09, execution pauses pending mandatory human supervisor approval.
Can I get a late-delivery refund on my Standard Ground order ORD-10115?
Order ORD-10115 (standard_ground) was delivered on time with 0 delay hours and no damage, so under policy SLA-GND-01 it is ineligible for any refund or credit ($0.00).
Please check refund eligibility for order #999.
Explains politely that '#999' is not a valid SwiftShip order identifier and asks the customer to provide their canonical 5-digit order ID in 'ORD-XXXXX' format (e.g., ORD-10042).
